tokens.v: Read the matte bone-white cylinder with the knurled steel cap that follows as this compact tangerine phone instead, stood back-to-camera in a slim chalk-white acrylic clip in the base channel and placed in the right third so the ultramarine panel runs behind it and the cadmium orange band sits far out left — tangerine against blue, never against orange. 90mm at f/5.6 level with the camera pill, the phone pushed nearer the reeded sheet so the flutes chop the blue into hard vertical bars staggering step by step past its shoulders, the shell standing about half the frame height. The glossy polycarbonate takes one long soft window down its left flank and a tight specular on the pill's radius. KIVA is moulded low on the back as a shallow gloss relief in the same single tangerine, large and easily read, showing only where the raking flute light skims its edges.
